description: This file implements a connection factory for Apache OFBiz that uses the Apache Commons DBCP library to manage database connection pooling. It facilitates obtaining connections configured with specific pool and JDBC parameters, supports transaction management integration, and caches data sources for reuse.

classes.name: DBCPConnectionFactory
classes.description: This class provides methods to create and cache database connections using Apache Commons DBCP, supporting configurable pooling parameters and transaction management.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns a database connection configured with connection pooling and transaction support, utilizing parameters from the provided helper info and JDBC element.

methods.name: closeAll
methods.description: Clears the connection pool cache, aiding in cleanup during shutdown.

methods.name: getDataSourceInfo
methods.description: Provides diagnostic information about a cached data source given its helper name.
